beats.text: Photorealistic, sharp, clean modern footage. ONE 8-second clip with ONE hard cut at exactly 4.0s. SHOT A (0.0-4.0s), fixed wide shot of the grassy athletics field exactly like image 1: [0.0-2.5s] the Shiba in the royal-blue tank top spins round twice on its hind legs, holding a rope with a small round ball on the end that swings around it; the two dogs in lime-green shirts watch. board_notes: Wide shot of a green grassy athletics field on a bright overcast day, trees and a low fence behind. The Shiba in a royal-blue sports tank top stands on its hind legs mid-spin, both front paws gripping a rope with a small round ball swinging out beside it; two dogs of other breeds in lime-green shirts stand to the right watching, one holding a clipboard.
Same wide shot of the same field. The rope and ball fly away sideways out of frame; the Shiba's front paws are empty and open, eyes wide; the two lime-green-shirt dogs jump back in surprise.
Same wide shot of the same field. The Shiba in the blue tank top has plopped down sitting on the grass, looking embarrassed; the lime-green-shirt dogs stare at it.

Medium close-up on a concert stage with a deep red velvet curtain behind, warm golden spotlight. The same Shiba in a black tuxedo jacket and white bow tie sits upright behind two silver microphones on stands, mouth wide open singing an opera note, showing teeth and tongue.
Closer shot, same stage and red curtain. The tuxedo Shiba holds a long high note, head tilted slightly back, mouth wide open, eyes half closed, very dramatic.
Same medium close-up on the stage with the red curtain. The tuxedo Shiba has finished singing: mouth closed, chin lifted, small proud smile, standing poised behind the two microphones.
remake.ending: Back on the same grass throwing field in daylight, the same Shiba Inu in the blue tank top stands calmly on a short leash; the lime-green-shirt official dog holds the leash handle (the real product from the image: the retractable leash with its anti-drop wrist band looped around its front paw), the Shiba smugly side-eyes the hammer lying far away on the grass.
